answer: Ambient entropy attestation prevents Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to localized physical phenomena. An operating kernel verifies unpredictable turbulence recorded from a knoll during a gale against surrounding peers. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying discrete physical sensor hardware across real geographic coordinates per identity. However, adversaries using advanced fluid dynamics models can computationally extrapolate local telemetry to fabricate identities.
